observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; for u in "/debates/new" "/debates/new?projekt_phase_id=2" "/proposals/new?projekt_phase_id=3" "/proposals"; do echo -n "$u -> "; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:3000$u"; done; echo "=== phase ids by type ==="; cd /workspace && PGPASSWORD=root psql -U root -h localhost -d consul_development -tAc "select id,type from projekt_phases where type like '%Debate%' limit 3;"
